text.title: Node.js Service Layer Implementation Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on whether the layering decisions and TypeScript are actually in place, then on the Express major and on which edge control is missing, to the rule that has to land before more handlers are written.

decision-tree.root-question: Does an approved layering artefact from nodejs-service-layer-architecture exist, and is the codebase TypeScript (or on an agreed migration)?

branch.when: no approved architecture artefact, or plain JavaScript with no TypeScript migration agreed

conclusion.verdict: skip; six of the rules are type-system or Prisma-specific and degrade to advice — emit a structured skip naming the missing precondition

branch.when: architecture artefact approved and the stack is TypeScript
branch.question: Which Express major is in use, and are async route handlers registered bare?

branch.when: Express 4 with bare async (req, res) handlers on a router

conclusion.verdict: wrap every async handler (catchAsync or express-async-handler) before anything else; an unhandled rejection under Node 15+ takes the process down

branch.when: Express 5, or Express 4 with every async handler already wrapped and the major stated in the artefact
branch.question: Which control at the edges is absent?

branch.when: controllers hand req.body straight through, or a service parameter is typed any, Request or an index-signature object

conclusion.verdict: parse body, query and params through a schema at the controller and type the service on the inferred type; req.body is any, so strict mode protects nothing here

branch.when: the terminal error handler has three parameters, or is registered before the routes, or echoes err.stack in production

conclusion.verdict: declare (err, req, res, next), register after all routers, and strip stack and message for unmapped errors when NODE_ENV is production

branch.when: Prisma known-request errors reach the middleware unmapped — a duplicate email returns 500

conclusion.verdict: translate P2002 to ConflictError, P2025 to NotFoundError and P2003 to ValidationError in the repository; no raw Prisma error may propagate past it

branch.when: service tests jest.mock the Prisma client, or all Jest workers share one database

conclusion.verdict: inject an in-memory repository for service tests and give each worker its own schema or container for repository tests against real PostgreSQL

branch.when: CI runs no type-aware lint — no parserOptions.project, no-floating-promises off

conclusion.verdict: set strict: true and run no-floating-promises and no-misused-promises with project-aware parsing in CI; an un-awaited write inside $transaction lands by event-loop timing

branch.when: all six controls already in place; the work is new handlers on the existing shape

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; implement controller, service, repository and error mapping in that order and emit the artefact with status=ready_for_review
